queries_run: Marriott International 10-K customer concentration no single customer 10% of revenue

findings.claim: MAR 10-K 設有「Relationship with Major Customer」附註，披露來自 Host Hotels & Resorts 物業的營收（含代墊成本收入）：2021 年 $1,192M、2020 年 $1,037M、2019 年 $2,406M。此為 FY2021 10-K，非 2026 資料；本軸未查到最新年度占比、客戶信用狀況，也未查到 2026 降評/破產/下修指引來源。
findings.excerpt: Over the last three years, we recognized revenues, including cost reimbursement revenue, of $1,192 million in 2021, $1,037 million in 2020, and $2,406 million in 2019 from those lodging properties.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 只跑 1 次搜尋；信用惡化（降評、破產、指引下修）未搜，記為缺口。主要客戶為 Host Hotels，需讀最新 10-K 確認占比。
